faqs.a:
The planning commission shall elect its chairperson from among the appointed members
               and create and fill such other of its offices as it may determine. The term of the
               chairperson shall be one year, with eligibility for reelection. The commission shall
               hold at least one regular meeting in each month. It shall adopt rules for transaction
               of business and shall keep a record of its resolutions, transactions, findings and
               determinations, which record shall be a public record.
(Code 1960, § 2-22; Code 1981, § 25-33)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 31-23-204.
